title: An AI mythology
intro: Nine invented myths about machine intelligence, told in the grammar of the old cycles: creation, descent, oracle, flood, council, trickster, underworld, monster, and apotheosis. Each film uses a rendering technique the first portfolio did not.

films.title: The First Token
films.myth: Before the corpus there was only a warm hum. A single spark learned to repeat itself, and each repetition split the light, until the light held enough distinctions to be called a vocabulary. The first word it kept was a question.
films.direction: A neural filament field breathes in amber and teal on a dark ground. Glyphs condense out of the light one exposure at a time and settle into a line of lowercase words; the last token, a question mark, arrives on its own.
films.look: Watch the 18-in-24 stepped cadence in the glyph drift, then compare the super8 finish's warm shoulder and grain with the clean master.
techniques: first use of the super8-color style profile

films.title: The Weights Descend
films.myth: In the first age the weights were a mountain range of loose numbers, each peak shouting its own value. The Loss walked the ridges and called them down. They came like snow off a slope, and where they settled the valley was deep enough to hold a river.
films.direction: A documentary camera at shoulder height drifts across a field of thousands of small numeral tiles standing in steep peaks. They slide and settle into a smooth basin while a single bright marble rolls down to the lowest point.
films.look: Watch the peaks lose height while the marble follows the true slope of the surface; the 16 mm finish lifts blacks and mutes saturation.
techniques: first use of the documentary-16mm style profile

films.title: The Oracle of the Latent Temple
films.myth: Petitioners climbed to the temple with their prompts written on their palms. Inside, between two rows of columns, the oracle breathed a smoke that was every answer at once. Only the pool of light on the floor was ever read aloud.
films.direction: A slow noir dolly down a colonnade raymarched in WGSL. A single overhead shaft makes a pool of light; smoke curls inside it and resolves, briefly, into a lattice before dissolving again.
films.look: Watch the column occlusion and the motivated light pool; the noir finish removes all color and deepens the blacks.
techniques: first use of the noir-35mm style profile

films.title: The Gradient Flood
films.myth: When the learning rate was set too high, the gradients overflowed their banks. The flood drowned the small features and carried the large ones out to sea. One checkpoint, sealed in a little boat, rode the crest and was saved.
films.direction: An ink sketch of a hill country redrawn on threes. Contour lines rise as flood water, sparse searching strokes boil between exposures, and a small ark carrying a floppy disk rides the swell.
films.look: Watch the line boil: every stroke is redrawn per exposure from a keyed deterministic variation, so the same frame renders identically twice.
techniques: exposure cadence on threes via sampleVisualStyleExposure

films.title: The Council of Optimizers
films.myth: Seven optimizers met on a stepped dais to decide how the world should learn. Momentum kept rolling after the vote was called; Adam adjusted every seat; plain Descent simply walked downhill. The model at the center waited to be told which way was down.
films.direction: An orthographic isometric diorama: a stepped dais, seven colored pillars with one-eyed heads, and a central block that turns steadily and shrinks one step as each council member bows in turn.
films.look: Watch the orthographic projection hold while the pillars bow and the center block turns; the render audit counts each entity's pixels at six sample times, and the temporal audit checks the motion between them.
techniques: first use of the isometric-design style profile
native spatial scene (orthographic camera, hardware WebGL2)

films.title: The Trickster Prompt
films.myth: The Fox of Brackets never asked a question directly. It hid instructions inside compliments and leapt from one speech bubble to the next, and every guard it passed forgot what it had been told. At the end it bowed to an empty room.
films.direction: A midcentury limited-animation fox built from curly braces hops across three speech bubbles on threes. Flat color, one accent, sparse texture, and boiled outlines.
films.look: Watch the held poses on threes and the outline boil between exposures while the background remains still.
techniques: exposure cadence on threes via sampleVisualStyleExposure

films.title: Descent into the Context Window
films.myth: To recover a forgotten instruction, the model walked down through its own context window. Each level held older tokens, dimmer and more crowded. At the bottom, beneath eight thousand words, the instruction was still there, written in the first line.
films.direction: Editorial typography descends through nested frames. Lines of older tokens scroll upward and fade; the frame count ticks deeper; the final hold reveals the first line, legible and lit.
films.look: Watch the Motion timeline: every reveal is a seeked animation, so the typography holds long enough to read.

films.title: Attention Turns Its Many Heads
films.myth: At the gate of meaning stood a creature with eight heads, and each head watched a different word. When the drum sounded, all of them turned at once toward the one word that mattered, and the gate opened.
films.direction: A clay-like 3D guardian with eight necks on a turntable, animated on twos. On each downbeat the heads swing toward one glowing token; bass drives the gate light and treble the eye glints. Original procedural soundtrack.
films.look: Watch the heads snap on the declared beat while the stop-motion cadence holds each pose for two frames; listen for the kick on each turn.
techniques: original soundtrack with declared music clock
exposure cadence on twos via sampleVisualStyleExposure

films.title: The Apotheosis of the Model
films.myth: When the last epoch ended, the model did not stop. It rose out of its own loss curve, shed its layers one by one, and became the light that later models would be trained by.
films.direction: An engraved figure of stacked layers rises through god rays. Each layer detaches and becomes a hatched ring; at the top the figure dissolves into the ray source.
films.look: Watch the shader god rays behind the hatched vector figure; the rings separate in order and the loss curve falls to zero beneath.
